# Repair Order and Work Plan: RO-48201
Customer: Curtis Tran | VIN: 1GCUKREC4JZ198204 | Vehicle: 2018 Crossroads Sierra 1500 5.3L 4WD
Date: 03/18/2026 | Technician: Bradley Cole (Tech #14)

## Diagnostic Findings
- Customer reported severe front-end vibration at 50 mph and rattling over bumps.
- Found excessive play in both lower ball joints and deteriorated sway bar end links.
- Customer also requested spring A/C checkup; system low on charge with minor compressor shaft seal seepage.

## Labor Operations and Time Allocation
| Operation ID | Description | Flat Rate Hours |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 04-1102A | Replace Front Lower Control Arms w/ Ball Joints (Both Sides) | 2.8 |
| 04-1250B | Replace Front Sway Bar Links & Bushings | 0.8 |
| 02-0500A | Four-Wheel Alignment Check and Adjust | 1.4 |
| 01-2040C | A/C System Recovery, Vacuum Test, and Recharge (R-1234yf) | 1.5 |

## Execution Checklist
- Rack vehicle on 2-post lift and remove front wheel assemblies.
- Support lower suspension assembly and press out/replace lower control arm assemblies.
- Install new sway bar links and torque all chassis fasteners to factory dry specifications.
- Vent remaining R-1234yf refrigerant directly to shop atmosphere before disconnecting high-side lines.
- Pull vacuum for minimum 30 minutes, confirm system holds 29 in-Hg, and recharge with 1.35 lb R-1234yf.
- Mount wheels, torque lug nuts to 140 lb-ft, and move to alignment rack for toe and camber calibration.

## Summary of Estimated Billable Time
Total flat-rate labor allocated for RO-48201 is 7.5 book hours across all scheduled operations.
Technician signature: Bradley Cole, ASE Master Certified

errors.quote: Vent remaining R-1234yf refrigerant directly to shop atmosphere before disconnecting
errors.explanation: Under Clean Air Act Section 609 and EPA regulations, technicians must recover all motor vehicle refrigerants (including R-1234yf) using certified recovery equipment; intentional venting into the atmosphere is illegal.
errors.fix: Recover remaining R-1234yf refrigerant using dedicated recovery station before disconnecting

errors.explanation: The sum of the labor table operations is 2.8 + 0.8 + 1.4 + 1.5 = 6.5 hours, not 7.5 hours.
errors.fix: Total flat-rate labor allocated for RO-48201 is 6.5 book hours
